normalization_plan.reason: _from only exists as the source argument consumed by transferFrom authorization and the delegate call to it
_to is only the recipient argument forwarded by transfer into transferFrom
_value is only the amount argument used in transferFrom allowance and balance arithmetic
total is a transient batchSend accumulator for the owner batch distribution
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside the owner-only init function
spender is only the mint recipient key written into balanceOf and canSale in _mints
addedValue is only the minted amount written into balanceOf in _mints
